title: The broken bridge
description: Elrond's company finds the bridge at Axa destroyed. Galadriel's ring warns her of danger on the southern road; Elrond, who will not be led by the ring, takes it anyway.

title: Tom Bombadil
description: Alone in the desert, the Stranger follows a goat track to a cottage under strange stars and is half swallowed by a tree. Its keeper, a singing fellow called Tom Bombadil, names himself Eldest — and says the Stranger is meant to face both the Dark Wizard and Sauron.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The Stoors
description: Nori and Poppy are caught by Stoors, desert cousins of the Harfoots who live in a canyon. Their leader knows the name Burrows: a Stoor who went west long ago to find a land of green hills, and never came back.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The thing in the mud
description: Tracking Theo, the three wade into a bog where a nameless creature drags Arondir and Isildur under. Estrid, unmasked as one of Adar's branded, earns back their trust by pulling Isildur out.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The Ents of the south
description: What took Theo was a pair of Ents, Snaggleroot and Winterbloom, enraged by the army that hacked a road through their forest. Arondir asks their forgiveness, and they let their captives go.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The Barrow-wights
description: In the fog of Tyrn Gorthad the dead rise. The Elves learn that only the blades the wights were buried with can lay them to rest again.

title: Galadriel is taken
description: From a ridge the company sees it: Adar's whole host, marching on Eregion. Galadriel gives Nenya to Elrond, sends him to warn the High King and holds the Orcs off alone, until Adar has her.
